project_type: ASP.NET Boilerplate (ABP) Framework - modular application framework with 30+ source projects
build_system: NUKE build system with build.sh/build.ps1 wrappers. SDK-style .csproj files with common.props for shared metadata.
test_framework: xunit with Shouldly assertions, NSubstitute for mocking. Tests in /test/ directory.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'dotnet build Abp.sln' from repo root. 2. Run 'dotnet test Abp.sln --no-build' to verify tests pass.
setup_instructions: Requires .NET 10.0 SDK (10.0.100). Run 'dotnet restore Abp.sln' then 'dotnet build Abp.sln'.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access for NuGet packages. Target is net10.0 across all projects.
contribution_requirements: SDK-style .csproj format. Castle Windsor for DI. Both Newtonsoft.Json and System.Text.Json supported via UseNewtonsoft flag.
key_patterns: Projects use common.props for versioning (11.0.0). configureawait.props for async patterns. Fody 6.9.3 for IL weaving. Castle Windsor DI container (not Microsoft DI directly). AbpDbContext base class with query filters for soft delete/multi-tenancy. IClockProvider custom time abstraction. JsonExtensions supports both Newtonsoft.Json and System.Text.Json via UseNewtonsoft flag.
directory_structure: src/ contains 30+ library projects (Abp, Abp.AspNetCore, Abp.EntityFrameworkCore, etc.), test/ contains matching test projects, build/ has NUKE build project, doc/ has documentation.
